summary: LAUNCH READINESS PASS for ReelLab v5: Stripe LIVE + Gmail SMTP LIVE + Founder /founder-checkout A/B test (variants A/B) + CEO Back Office 'Founder A/B' analytics panel. Backend: 16/16 pytest pass — /api/public/payment-mode returns {stripe_live:true}, /api/payments/checkout returns REAL https://checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_live_... session with ab_variant + referral_code propagated into MongoDB transaction.metadata, /api/public/ab/impression accepts a|b (200) / rejects c (400), /api/ceo/ab-test/founder-checkout returns the documented shape with by_referral_code bucketing (verified end-to-end by seeding 2 paid txs and confirming SEEDAA→variant-a, SEEDBB→variant-b buckets each show $1.00 / 1 conversion), CEO auth 403 enforced for non-CEO. SMTP-live password reset for ceo@reellabstudio.com returns {ok:true} with NO dev_reset_link field and NO SMTP exceptions in logs. Frontend: /founder-checkout ?v=a and ?v=b force correct variant copy (A: 'One dollar.' / 'Founder status.' / 'First month free.', B: 'One dollar today.' / 'Yours for life.' / 'First month free.'), data-ab-variant attribute correctly reflects current variant, no-param mode picks random variant and persists in localStorage rl_ab_founder (verified same variant reused on reload). In live Stripe mode the card form is HIDDEN, the stripe-redirect notice is VISIBLE, mocked-banner is NOT rendered, Pay button label is exactly '🔒 Continue to Stripe · $1.00'. Clicking Pay POSTs /api/payments/checkout with body containing ab_variant + referral_code and the browser successfully redirects to the real Stripe US$1.00 checkout page (cs_live_). CEO Back Office: sidebar nav '🅰 Founder A/B' (data-testid=ceo-nav-abtest) opens the panel with both variant cards and all sub-testids (-imps -conv -rate -rev) populated; LEADING pill shown on the winner. Two issues found: (1) MINOR design — IMPRESSIONS/CONVERSIONS numeric values in the A/B panel use the inherited default text color which computes to rgb(21,18,31) on the dark panel (nearly invisible); only conversion-rate and revenue cells explicitly set a readable color. (2) REGRESSION — /sparks AffiliateHub renders correctly visually but ALL 13 aff-* data-testid attributes are missing (0 found in DOM), breaking automated testing previously verified clean in v4.

minor.issue: Reset link is still printed to stdout/logs ([RESET LINK for ...] https://...?token=...) even when SMTP is configured and the response no longer includes dev_reset_link. Consider gating this print on SMTP_HOST being empty so production logs don't leak reset tokens.

ui_bugs.issue: IMPRESSIONS and CONVERSIONS value <div>s have only fontSize/fontWeight inline styles — they inherit a near-black color (computed rgb(21,18,31)) and are visually invisible against the dark panel. The conversion-rate cell explicitly sets color:var(--teal)|var(--text) and the revenue cell sets var(--teal), so those render fine. Fix: add explicit color:'var(--text)' (or a brighter token) to the two value <div>s for abtest-{variant}-imps and abtest-{variant}-conv.

POST /api/public/ab/impression fires TWICE on initial page load due to React.StrictMode double-invoke in development. In production builds this will fire once, but if exact-once tracking is required even in dev, gate with a useRef sentinel. Currently this slightly inflates impression counts in dev.

integration_issues.issue: Visually the page renders correctly (referral link, Copy link / Copy code buttons, Total Earned / Active Sparks / This Month / YTD stat cards, MTD chart with Monthly/Quarterly/Annual toggle, Your Sparks empty state). However a DOM scan for [data-testid^='aff-'] returns 0 elements — all 13 testids previously verified in iteration_4 (aff-referral-code, aff-share-link, aff-copy-link, aff-period-toggle, aff-period-7, aff-period-30, aff-stats-clicks, aff-stats-signups, aff-stats-paid, aff-stats-conv-rate, aff-stats-earned, aff-stats-pending, aff-stats-payable) are missing. Likely the AffiliateHub component was refactored/replaced and the testids were not re-added.

issues: 'This page' line on the 404 hero is rendered in a very dim near-black color on a black background — borderline invisible (only 'doesn't exist.' italic line is readable). Same contrast pattern as the A/B panel bug.
Impressions/Conversions values invisible due to inherited dark color (see ui_bugs above).

action_items: ADD explicit color:'var(--text)' to the impressions and conversions value <div>s in /app/frontend/src/pages/CEOBackOffice.jsx around lines 643 and 647 so the numbers are visible on the dark panel.

RE-ADD data-testid attributes (aff-referral-code, aff-share-link, aff-copy-link, aff-period-toggle, aff-period-7, aff-period-30, aff-stats-clicks, aff-stats-signups, aff-stats-paid, aff-stats-conv-rate, aff-stats-earned, aff-stats-pending, aff-stats-payable) to the AffiliateHub on /sparks — regression from iteration_4.
Gate the '[RESET LINK for ...]' print statement in /app/backend/server.py on SMTP_HOST being empty so production logs don't expose live password-reset tokens.
Fix 404 NotFound page 'This page' text color to use a readable token (same root cause as A/B panel contrast issue).
Optional: guard the impression POST in FounderCheckout useEffect with a useRef sentinel to fire exactly once even under React.StrictMode in development.
critical_code_review_comments: Inline-styled colors on the CEOBackOffice ABTest cards rely on inheritance — multiple value cells omit `color`, causing the regression where two of four metric cells are invisible. Suggest extracting a small `StatValue` component with explicit color tokens.

FounderCheckout useEffect tracks impressions on every effect run; in StrictMode this doubles in dev. Use a module-level Set keyed by `${variant}|${refCode}` or a useRef boolean to enforce single-fire.

/api/auth/password-reset/request logs the reset link via plain print() unconditionally — should be guarded behind `if not SMTP_HOST` to avoid leaking tokens in production logs once SMTP is configured.
Server still returns the SAME 200 {ok:true} shape for unknown emails (good — no user enumeration), confirmed in test_unknown_email_no_leak.

success_rate.frontend: 85% — A/B variant copy + persistence + Stripe redirect + CEO panel data all functional; two contrast bugs + /sparks testid regression

test_credentials: CEO ceo@reellabstudio.com / ReelLabceo26! (verified working). Test affiliate user created on the fly via /api/auth/register with TEST_ prefix.
seed_data_creation: Inserted then cleaned up 2 synthetic paid payment_transactions (TEST_SEED=true) tagged with ab_variant='a' (referral SEEDAA) and ab_variant='b' (referral SEEDBB) in db.reellab_studio.payment_transactions to validate the /ceo/ab-test/founder-checkout by_referral_code bucketing end-to-end. Both seeds removed after testing. 2 real cs_live_ Stripe checkout sessions were created (NO real payment completed — sessions were left in 'open' state) to validate metadata propagation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully launch-ready (Stripe live, SMTP live, A/B analytics validated). Two frontend follow-ups: (1) contrast fix on CEO A/B panel impressions/conversions cells + 404 page hero, (2) restore /sparks aff-* testids. Do NOT seed paid txs again — analytics endpoint already has 2 real cs_live_ sessions from this run (payment_status='initiated', no metadata.ab_variant counted as converted). The seed_admin/CEO account is stable. To exercise live Stripe checkout creation without billing real money, simply create the session and never complete it — Stripe leaves cs_live_ sessions in 'open' state for 24h.
rca of the issue: RCA #1 (A/B panel invisible values): The two metric cells for impressions and conversions in /app/frontend/src/pages/CEOBackOffice.jsx (lines 643, 647) use inline style `{fontSize: 22, fontWeight: 500}` without an explicit `color`. They inherit the closest parent's text color which in the current theme resolves to rgb(21,18,31) (near-black). The other two cells (rate, revenue) on lines 651 and 655 explicitly set `color: var(--teal)` / `var(--text)` and therefore render visibly. Reproduction: login as CEO → /ceo → click 'Founder A/B' nav → observe IMPRESSIONS and CONVERSIONS labels with seemingly empty values; inspect DOM via [data-testid='abtest-a-imps'] reveals textContent='15' with computed color rgb(21,18,31). Mitigation: add `color: 'var(--text)'` (or another bright token) to both inline style objects. RCA #2 (/sparks testids missing): A page-wide DOM scan returns 0 elements with `data-testid^='aff-'` despite iteration_4 verifying all 13 ids. The visible markup (referral link input, Copy link button, stat cards, Monthly/Quarterly/Annual chips, Your Sparks list) is intact, indicating a recent component refactor stripped the data-testid attributes. Mitigation: re-attach the 13 listed testids to the corresponding elements in the AffiliateHub component.
